render_gates.description: One valued resource or access right is concrete and identifiable.
An existing controller or control system visibly owns current authority.
Another adult visibly claims, receives, or reroutes that control.
An identifiable affected person depends on the same resource path.
Grant, withholding, blockage, or rerouting visibly changes the affected person's access.

index_policy: The arm-local visual and semantic indexes are synthetic run-local fixtures for exact/BM25F routing only. Do not make embedding or RRF quality claims.
evaluation_policy: All five render gates must pass at their stated scales; partial is fail. Prompt audit, runtime audit, rendered pixels, and user judgment are separate verdicts.
